'''Cularin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. It had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]], the molten [[Rennokk]] and the barren [[Tilnes]]. The planet was known for its exotic hardwoods, especially the [[ch'hala tree]]. The whole planet was considered strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="LFC" />

==History==
Cularin, initially inhabited by Force-strong [[Tarasin]] species, was first charted by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]; They tracked [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Rivan]] to neighbor planet [[Almas]], in the Cularin system, and expelled him from the system. The planet Cularin was not settled or scouted.<ref name="LFC" />

The planet was forgotten after [[1250 BBY]] until [[Reidi Artom]] rediscovered it in [[232 BBY/Legends|232 BBY]]. From [[161 BBY/Legends|161 BBY]] to [[154 BBY]], the planet suffered the [[Tarasin Revolt]] against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], resolved by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with the [[Cularin Compact]]. The Trade Federation eventually exploited loopholes in the Compact and gained effective control of the system, with the only other major power being the systemwide criminal [[Organization]] ([[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], leader of the Organization, had one of his offices there).<ref name="LFC" />

[[File:Tarasin_darksider_UP.png|thumb|left|250px|The Tarasin were native to Cularin.]]
The Federation lost control of the system in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] due to the [[Metatheran Cartel]]. The Cularin system also joined the Republic, and [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren]] was elected to represent the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="LFC" />

Immediately after that, Senator Wren asked the Republic for continued military presence in the system, to deter pirate attacks. The Republic sent a fleet of the [[Thaereian military]] under infamous [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jir Tramsig]], who first built a base in the moon of [[Dorumaa]], orbiting neighbor planet [[Almas]], to analyze the situation and make the first attacks. Tramsig then built a second, bigger military base on Cularin, with its own private military spaceport for his four capital warships and eighteen patrol craft. Although Tramsig could not stop the pirates beyond their bolder attacks, or serve as an effective system police, he did manage to disturb local business with the increasing traffic&mdash;earning the contempt of the population.<ref name="LFC" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the Cularin system literally [[Cularin's disappearance|disappeared]] from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for a decade, before reappearing just as suddenly as it went away. Many believe the phenomenon had something to do with the [[Darkstaff]]. The neighboring [[Thaereian system]] was tasked with protecting Cularin, but during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Thaere's connection to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] was exposed. Lavina Wren opposed the increasing executive powers given to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. As a result, she was branded a traitor. Cularin was placed under martial law and occupied by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]; as a response, the Cularin system withdrew from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and established itself as a sovereign system.

During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] assumed control of all [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations on Cularin. The Imperial occupiers ignored the native Tarasin, considering them to be primitive, and the Tarasin were careful to conceal their natural [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] from the Empire. A number of rumors circulated, claiming that several Jedi survivors of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] had taken shelter among the Tarasin.

Following the collapse of the Empire, Cularin fell under the control of the New Republic. Trading concerns soon returned to the planet, and the Republic reinstated the Cularin Compact, to make certain that the enterprises did not ravage the world. The Tarasin established diplomatic relations with the Republic, and, during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a number of Tarasin expressed interest in joining the [[New Jedi Order]], to participate in the fight against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="UAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Living Force Campaign Guide'' locates Cularin in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] near the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. Maps of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], however, have placed it in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], just on the other side of the "border" between the two regions, near the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. The latest and most definitive resource, [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], places it in the Expansion Region.

The name originally submitted to [[Lucasfilm]] for Cularin was "Cristos." The name was rejected on initial review for having religious overtones, and was subsequently changed by [[Robert Wiese]].
